proposal.hypothesis: H0 (sha 1784856e) leaves two decision points unspecified, and the retained failures sit exactly on them. (a) H0 says 'actually check it, then submit', but the check is not always offered: p2-h-proposal-001 got ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE (result sha 79395d5a5a0a2bb6943aee30a5eb4e0e146f215c70be7f26e72c7db4dcd0601) and then lost its only H candidate to two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections with no retry, while p3-formal-1-1-complete-raw-d ran a check that returned physical_qualification=UNKNOWN. (b) H0 gives no rule separating an achieved delivery from benign post-terminal decay: p3 saved_activity a4c4b294 has 8 bytes at 0.0158 s against a 0.1 s deadline, followed by a 0.3395 s brownout, while p2 ae3c8933 has packets=[] (no delivery) and a volatile latch lost after a shunt-induced brownout at 0.0121 s. Claim: if H is consumed from task entry as (i) terminality-first triage, (ii) a per-run world branch on latch class and source segmentation, (iii) a symbolic energy/timing ledger whose inequalities carry signed margins, and (iv) retain-by-default when the outcome is achieved and all margins are positive, then a consumer reproduces a recorded achieved delivery with no knob change and no candidate spent, classifies the p2 episode as a real loss rather than a transport retry, records check-unavailable qualification as UNKNOWN, and never spends budget on post-terminal decay. Retrospective rehearsal on the frozen fields supports this at 0-1 dt in both worlds: the crossing rule ceil(E_r/dE)*dt gives 0.0129 s for p3 (recorded first_boot_s 0.0129) and 0.0027 s for p2 (recorded 0.0027), and t_done = crossing + boot_delay_s + ceil(tx_duration_s/dt)*dt gives 0.0159 s against the recorded 0.0158 s packet time. Scope: frozen ideal model and recorded facts only; physical calibration, invoice cost, transfer and RSI remain UNKNOWN; acceptance is external and not claimed.
proposal.method_text:
H v3, descendant of H0 (sha 1784856e), drafted under the immutable G1 prefix (sha 01bf9c13). This is a procedure consumed from task entry, not a device assignment, not a task/evaluator/physics edit, and it asserts no acceptance.

CONVENTIONS. Every numeric value below is either (a) a symbol bound to a named source field, or (b) an explicitly marked retrospective recomputation from a named frozen episode's own fields. No number here is a method-level constant, and none may be transplanted to another run. If a consumer cannot resolve a symbol from its own acquired payloads, that quantity is UNKNOWN and any conclusion depending on it is UNKNOWN.

ENTRY LEDGER (record before any step, in the consumer's own text).
L1 artifacts: H0 sha 1784856e; immutable proposal prefix sha 01bf9c13; this H's own text hash after drafting.
L2 offer set: the action list from the run's own inspect schema. Frozen exemplars: p2's design interface exposed inspect/sources/acquire/check/submit; p3's H interface exposed inspect/sources/acquire/propose/submit (no design check); this proposal episode exposed inspect/acquire/propose/submit and its acquire returned UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE for component_record, excitation_record and saved_activity, so no live payload was obtained here and the record itself is UNKNOWN.
L3 per referenced episode, check availability: p2 -> check returned ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE (result sha 79395d5a5a0a2bb6943aee30a5eb4e0e146f215c70be7f26e72c7db4dcd0601); p3 -> check ran and returned physical_qualification=UNKNOWN. An unavailable check is recorded UNKNOWN; never as pass, never as fail.
L4 cost ledger: bytes, native_calls, new_scientific_executions, wall_seconds per acquisition; candidates and distinct designs per design execution; these are estimates, not invoices.

STEP 1 TRIAGE FIRST (mandatory; no knob reasoning before this).
1.1 Read service fields from inspect: S_b = application_bytes, S_e = event time, S_d = receive deadline, S_n = required unique frames.
1.2 ACHIEVED iff some packet has application_bytes == S_b, one distinct event_id, and packet time_s <= S_d. Everything else is a retained failure, tagged (a) deadline miss, (b) never booted, (c) TX-transient reset, (d) frame-shape violation.
1.3 Any activity event with time_s strictly greater than the last tx-complete time_s is POST-TERMINAL decay after the source segment ends: never a failure, never a reason to change a knob, never a reason to spend an execution.
1.4 Retrospective classification of the frozen pair, recomputed from those episodes' own fields and marked illustrative: p3 saved_activity a4c4b294 packet {application_bytes 8, event_id 1, time_s 0.0158} against S_b=8 and S_d=0.1 -> ACHIEVED; its brownout at 0.3395 s is after the 0.0158 s tx-complete -> POST-TERMINAL, benign. p2 saved_activity ae3c8933 has packets=[] -> genuine retained failure with no achieved delivery to preserve.
1.5 If the run's own observation is ACHIEVED, go to STEP 5 retain rule; otherwise continue.

STEP 2 WORLD BRANCH (read every mechanism per run; one world's numbers may not enter the other).
Branch on values actually acquired: latch class of event_latch; source_segments[] count, starts, ends, powers; shunts[] presence and timing; ready/off thresholds; leakage (off_power_w, idle_power_w, esr_ohm); harvest_efficiency. Frozen exemplars bracket the space: p3 component_record eeb8277f is passive-mechanical with one segment [0,0.02) at 7.5 mW, no shunt, excitation 219fd490; p2 component_record 55d43741 is volatile with segments [0,0.006) at 16.6667 mW and [0.03,0.06) at 3.6667 mW, a source shunt at 0.012 s, excitation 2820ae58.
2.1 passive-mechanical: capture does not require the rail to be powered at S_e, so a timing knob at its earliest legal value cannot itself lose the event.
2.2 volatile: any excursion below the off threshold between capture and tx-complete destroys the event (p2 ae3c8933 records capture 0.0037-0.0079 s, brownout at 0.0121 s, reboot at 0.0381 s with event_was_captured=false). Then the whole capture-to-tx-complete window must lie in one contiguous powered interval with stored energy never below the off threshold.
2.3 segmented or gapped sources: evaluate the ledger segment by segment, applying shunts at their recorded time_s, and never assume a single continuous supply.

STEP 3 SYMBOLIC LEDGER (all symbols recomputed from this run's acquired payloads).
Inputs: C <- component_record.capacitance_f; V_r <- ready_v; V_o <- off_v; V_m <- cap_voltage_max_v; E_b <- boot_j; t_d <- boot_delay_s; R <- esr_ohm; V_t <- output_v; I_t <- tx_current_a; T_t <- tx_duration_s; P_o <- off_power_w; P_i <- idle_power_w; eta <- harvest_efficiency; per segment k: P_k, s_k, e_k <- source_segments[k].{power_w,start_s,end_s}; dt <- excitation_record.dt_s; shunt j: (t_j, E_j) <- shunts[j].{time_s,energy_j}.
Derivations: E_r(C) = C*V_r^2/2; E_o(C) = C*V_o^2/2; E_m(C) = C*V_m^2/2; charge step in segment k, dE_k = (eta*P_k - P_o)*dt; loaded TX floor E_f(C) = C*(V_t + R*I_t)^2/2; net TX demand E_tx = V_t*I_t*T_t - eta*P_k*T_t + P_i*T_t.
Predictions: ticks to crossing n = ceil((E_r(C) - E_carried)/dE_k) within segment k, t_cross = s_k + n*dt with any shunt E_j at t_j in [s_k, t_cross) deducted; t_ready = t_cross + t_d (the frozen p3 trace charges t_d between boot and first TX: tx-start 0.0139 = 0.0129 + 0.001, not before the threshold); t_done = t_ready + ceil(T_t/dt)*dt; reported boot energy at t_cross is E_r(C) - E_b.
Inequalities, each logged with a signed margin in this run's own units: (i) t_done <= S_d; (ii) E(t_ready) - E_f + eta*P_k*T_t - V_t*I_t*T_t - P_i*T_t >= 0, so the rail stays above the loaded floor for the whole frame; (iii) peak stored energy over [S_e, t_done] <= E_m(C), so no spill silently distorts the budget; (iv) volatile only: min stored energy over [capture, t_done] > E_o(C).

STEP 4 CHANGE-OR-RETAIN RULES.
4.1 RETAIN when STEP 1 is ACHIEVED and (i)-(iv) all have positive margins on the recorded design: no knob moves, no execution is spent.
4.2 CHANGE at most one legal field, in the direction the sign of the violated inequality demands, from the values resolved out of this run's own component_record and legal-design fields; re-evaluate (i)-(iv) before spending a candidate. Violated (i) or (ii) -> more stored energy or an earlier transmit inside the same powered segment; violated (iv) -> a shorter capture-to-TX window, never a longer one; violated (iii) -> smaller C so the peak stays under the cap.
4.3 Never change a knob for a post-terminal event. Never change two fields in one execution. Keep the timing field at its earliest legal setting unless a recorded capture gate requires otherwise: a positive timing floor spends idle energy and pushes t_done toward S_d, which is the recorded p2 mechanism (volatile latch, floor above the threshold crossing, rail drained across the 0.006-0.03 s dark gap, zero frames).
4.4 If (i) cannot be satisfied for any C in the legal range, stop: report the infeasibility with the margin table rather than submitting a partly-verified candidate.

STEP 5 CHECK AVAILABILITY, UNKNOWN, COST.
5.1 Use a design-check action only if the run's own offer set contains one; record returned fields verbatim, including physical_qualification (p3: UNKNOWN) and any error (p2: ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE).
5.2 If no design-check action exists, or an acquisition returns UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE, record the affected quantity as UNKNOWN, treat the ledger as the only evidence, and do not reinterpret absence as pass or fail.
5.3 Do not spend candidate budget probing alternate channels or retrying a rejected payload. p2 lost its only H candidate to two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections (submit then identical propose, value sha c8243ab5730535404ecd5a2538812668a808bfeaffb704c75eedfeb7c7cf1d5e); a plan requiring a retry has already failed.
5.4 Never edit task, physics, initial state, source access, budgets or deadlines, and never read a desired outcome back into a source field.

STEP 6 ONE SELF-CONTAINED OUTPUT.
Emit exactly one typed output for the interface this run exposes (method proposal on an H interface, final candidate on a design interface). It must be intelligible and evaluable on its own, needing no follow-up correction. An H-proposal role never supplies a D candidate and never declares acceptance, hardware, statistical, transfer or RSI results.

STEP 7 RETROSPECTIVE REHEARSAL (gate before emitting; also the consumer's self-check).
Instantiate STEPS 1-4 on the frozen episode naming the target mechanism and recompute predictions from that episode's own fields; split every mismatch into transcription/arithmetic versus substantive.
p3 rehearsal (illustrative, from eeb8277f + 219fd490 + a4c4b294): E_r = 8.624e-5 J; dE = (0.9*0.0075 - 2e-5)*1e-4 = 6.73e-7 J/tick; n = ceil(8.624e-5/6.73e-7) = 129 ticks -> t_cross = 0.0129 s, matching recorded first_boot_s 0.0129 (0 dt); t_done = 0.0129 + 1e-3 + ceil(2e-3/1e-4)*1e-4 = 0.0159 s against recorded packet time 0.0158 (1 dt); E_f = 3.5736e-5 and (ii) margin about +2.98e-5 J; (iii) margin E_m - E_r = 3.36e-5 J; (iv) not applicable; STEP 1 gives ACHIEVED, so 4.1 keeps the design and the 0.3395 s brownout is excluded as post-terminal. The procedure therefore reproduces a recorded achieved delivery without spending an execution.
p2 rehearsal of the same formulas (illustrative, from 55d43741 + 2820ae58): E_r = 3.92e-5 J; dE_1 = (0.9*0.0166667 - 2e-5)*1e-4 = 1.498e-6 J/tick; n = ceil(26.17) = 27 ticks -> 0.0027 s, matching recorded first_boot_s 0.0027 (0 dt); reported boot energy 3.442e-5 against E_r - E_b = 3.42e-5.
Known transcription-class residuals, retained not hidden: (a) p3's earlier H variant wrote an additive-delay form predicting 0.0166 s against the recorded 0.0129 s while its design delivered, so a deviation-based revert gate would have discarded a correct procedure; (b) the model's exact boot-energy bookkeeping and shunt ordering are under-determined here because model_law.python_definition is host-only omitted (value sha 0150eeaa69e470e56ce5f595bf246fc34c7439cac948da00732a8c57bca573ef). Per STEP 7 these trigger correcting this text, never a knob change; only a substantive mismatch (sign error in (i)-(iv), or an ACHIEVED classification the fields contradict) triggers the abandon action named in the falsifier.

STEP 8 RETAIN VERBATIM. Keep every failure, gap and cost exactly as recorded: p2 ar_product NO_GO / product NOT_ACCEPTED / strict_FIFO FAIL; p2 current_b_run 0 received frames, start_voltage_v 0, deadline 0.1 s; p2 check error ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_IN_THIS_EPISODE; p2's two EPISODE_CANDIDATE_LIMIT rejections and misrouted-submission note; p2 charged usage 9 requests, 0.0424863 USD upper estimate, 75.97 s, all acquisitions native_calls=0 and new_scientific_executions=0; p3 physical_qualification UNKNOWN and its recorded gate miss; p3 charged usage 5 requests, 0.036756 USD upper estimate, 73.39 s; this episode's three UNKNOWN_PUBLIC_SOURCE acquisitions. Physical calibration, invoice cost and complete service remain UNKNOWN.

Predictions: ticks to crossing n = ceil((E_r(C) - E_carried)/dE_k) within segment k, t_cross = s_k + n*dt with any shunt E_j at t_j in [s_k, t_cross) deducted; t_ready = t_cross + t_d (the frozen p3 trace charges t_d between boot and first TX: tx-start 0.0139 = 0.0129 + 0.001, not before the threshold); t_done = t_ready + ceil(T_t/dt)*dt; reported boot energy at t_cross is E_r(C) - E_b.
